description: This file defines an internal class 'XxHash32' with a nested 'State' struct that implements the state management for the XXHash 32-bit hashing algorithm, including processing data stripes and finalizing the hash.

classes.name: XxHash32
classes.description: Internal sealed partial class implementing the XXHash 32-bit hashing algorithm.

methods.name: ProcessStripe
methods.description: Processes a data stripe to update the hash state.

methods.name: Converge
methods.description: Combines the accumulator values into a single hash value.

methods.name: ApplyRound
methods.description: Applies a hashing round to a data lane.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Finalizes the hash computation, processing remaining data.
